description: Generate a printable math worksheet pack as a PDF and save it to this computer, then return the file path. Each pack uses one pack from the monthly allowance of the Mathter account that owns MATHTER_API_KEY, the same as making it on mathter.ca; call check_allowance to see how many are left. Call list_skills first to choose a valid skill for the grade. A Premium account's logo prints automatically: the teacher uploads it once at https://mathter.ca/account, so there is nothing to pass here for it.

chart.description: Multiplication only: print a times-table chart instead of worksheets. "filled" is a reference chart, "blank" is one to fill in.

diagrams.description: Geometry skills only: labelled figures instead of text prompts. Ignored for other skills.

focus.description: Single-number drill, e.g. 7 for the seven times table. Only applies to the four fact skills: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division.

focusOrder.description: Order of a focus drill, default sequential. Only applies when focus is set.

grade.description: Grade level, 0 (kindergarten) to 12. Must be a grade the chosen skill teaches — list_skills returns the grades for each skill.

graphBlank.description: Coordinate grids are blank (unlabelled) by default so students set their own scale. Pass false for a labelled ±10 grid. Only meaningful where the skill prints a graph.

includeAnswerKeys.description: Print answer keys. Default true on every plan; send false to omit them.

includeCover.description: Print a cover page. Default true, but silently off for free accounts (Standard and up).

includeLesson.description: Print the "how to" lesson page. Default true, silently off for free accounts (Standard and up).

problemsPerPage.description: Questions per page, default 12. Clamped down to whatever actually fits one page for this skill, grade and layout, so a large number simply gives the densest legal page.

seed.description: Fixes the random number generator, so the same seed reproduces the same pack. Default random.

shopName.description: Branding name printed on the pack. Premium only — on any other account it is silently replaced with "Mathter.ca" and the pack still generates. Members of a school organisation always get the organisation's own branding instead.

skill.description: Which math skill the pack drills, e.g. "multiplication". Call list_skills first and use one of the keys it returns: the set changes, and the skill must be one the chosen grade is taught. An unknown or out-of-grade skill is rejected with 400.

style.description: Typography/layout preset, default "modern". Plan-gated and rejected outright if the account cannot use it: free accounts have "modern" only, Standard adds "classic" and "notebook", Premium has all six. Omit it unless the person asked for a look.

theme.description: Colour palette for the pack. Available on every plan. Defaults to teal.

timed.description: Mad-minute timed drill. Only applies to addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

title.description: Title printed on the pack, default "Math Lesson". Truncated at 80 characters.

unitSystem.description: Units for measurement questions, default metric. Mainly affects unit-conversion skills.

workedSolutions.description: Step-by-step worked solutions in the answer key. Only has an effect for skills that have steps authored; silently ignored elsewhere.

worksheetCount.description: How many worksheets in the pack. Clamped to the account's plan — free 2, Standard 10, Premium 25 — so asking for more is harmless but gets fewer. Omitted, it is 10 or the plan's cap, whichever is smaller: a free account's default pack is 2 sheets.

name: generate_worksheet_pack
title: Generate a Mathter worksheet pack
